title: Publishing source versions
content: A source replacement is staged with all of its chunks before publication. One transaction marks the previous active version superseded and publishes the complete replacement. Readers see either complete version, never partial chunks.

title: Database backups
content: PostgreSQL stores durable workspace, source, version and chunk records. Backups require a documented retention period and a tested restore procedure. Restarting the development container preserves its named data volume.

title: Lexical search
content: PostgreSQL full-text search uses the simple text-search configuration and a GIN index. The lexical ranking score is postgres_ts_rank_cd. Native PostgreSQL full-text ranking is not BM25 and the score is not a probability.

title: Synthetic vector checks
content: Synthetic vectors test storage dimensions and exact cosine distance only. Nullable embeddings allow lexical-only chunks. A synthetic vector does not establish semantic quality or verify an embedding model.

title: Workspace boundaries
content: The server resolves the development workspace context. Composite foreign keys and row-level security enforce scoped source references. A client-supplied filter cannot grant access to a different workspace.

title: Readiness and liveness
content: Liveness reports whether the API process is running. Database dependency readiness checks schema revision, the vector extension and committed active corpus rows. Database readiness alone does not advertise an executable search profile.

title: Identifiers and multilingual text
content: Identifier RAG_MVP_2026 and source-version-42 are searchable text examples. PostgreSQL simple configuration preserves non-English tokens: документация, пошук, безпека. No language-specific stemming is promised.

title: Operational diagnostics
content: Operational logs contain bounded correlation identifiers, safe status codes and durations. Document bodies, vector values, connection strings and credentials are excluded. Production authentication and tenant authorization require a separate implementation.
